title.zh: 将甲米地省特里亚斯将军市镇的General Trias小学更名为Diego Mojica纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the General Trias Elementary School in the Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, to Paaralang Pang-Alaala Kay Diego Mojica (Diego Mojica Memorial School)
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the General Trias Elementary School in the Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, to Paaralang Pang-Alaala Kay Diego Mojica (Diego Mojica Memorial School)

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6673_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the General Trials Elementary School in the Municipality of General Trias, Province of Cavite, is changed to Paaralang Pang-alaala kay Diego Mojica (Diego Mojica Memorial School).
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
